name: Pieter van Dijk
bio:
Pieter's journey into motorsport finance began unexpectedly after a career as a bookkeeper for a local tulip farm. His meticulous nature and sharp eye for detail caught the attention of a small racing team struggling with their accounts. He quickly adapted to the fast-paced world of racing, bringing a much-needed sense of order to their financial affairs.

Pieter believes in transparency and accuracy above all else. He meticulously tracks every expense, ensuring that the team operates within budget and avoids unnecessary risks. While he may not be a technical expert, his dedication to financial stability provides a solid foundation for the team's success. He's known for his unwavering loyalty and willingness to go the extra mile, even if it means working late into the night to balance the books.

physical.description: Pieter is a man of medium build with a kind face etched with years of experience.

quirks: Insists on using a fountain pen for all official documents.
Collects vintage motorsport posters, often found studying them during lunch breaks.
